Here is the comprehensive production endpoint directory for Adobe Firefly Services and Creative Cloud APIs, broken down systematically by base URL domains.
You can copy-paste these endpoints directly into your Postman collections, HTTP client configurations, or environment variables.

1. Identity & Access Management (Adobe IMS Platform)

• Base URL: https://adobelogin.com
http
POST https://adobelogin.com
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Exchanging your client_id and client_secret for a short-lived bearer access token via the client_credentials grant flow.

2. Core Generative AI APIs (Adobe Firefly Engines)

• Base URL: https://firefly-api.adobe.io
• Authentication Headers Required: Authorization: Bearer <token>, x-api-key: <client_id>

A. Image Generation & Modification

http
POST https://adobe.io
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Text-to-Image creation loops utilizing the native Firefly Image Model layers.
http
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Generative Fill, inpainting modifications, and localized content additions.
http
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Generative Expand, canvas bounds extensions, and outpainting synthesis patterns.
http
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Content upscaling and high-density image optimization.

B. Text Effects & Typography

http
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Stylization of programmatic text strings with dynamic asset patterns.

C. Video Generation

http
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Text-to-Video generation using Adobe’s enterprise video model architectures.

D. Product & Scene Composites

http
POST https://adobe.io
POST https://adobe.io
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Blending standalone object or product pictures seamlessly into generated background environments with matched lighting matrices.

E. Direct File Storage Gateway

http
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Uploading raw local canvas binary data blocks to fetch temporary source reference identifiers.

F. Inbound Job Lifecycles (Firefly Engine Context)

http
GET  https://firefly-api.adobe.io/v3/status/{jobId}
POST https://firefly-api.adobe.io/v3/cancel/{jobId}
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Direct tracking loops and cancellation hooks for asynchronous Firefly workloads.

3. Canvas Automation APIs (Photoshop & Lightroom Clouds)

• Base URL: https://image.adobe.io
• Service Engine Constraints: All incoming assets must be passed using signed bucket URLs (S3, Azure Blob, Dropbox).

A. Photoshop Headless Operations (v2 Pipeline Core)

http
POST https://image.adobe.io/v2/remove-background
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Segmenting and extracting foreground elements from composite assets.
http
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Segmenting semantic objects, backgrounds, and human profiles.
http
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Processing asset layer alterations and internal variable substitutions.
http
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Running typographical modifications on active text layers.
http
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Intelligently identifying layout subjects and applying calculated boundary crops.
http
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Programmatically running Photoshop ATN files converted into automated JSON strings.
http
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Assembling new structural PSD templates or writing out multi-layer documents.

B. Lightroom Headless Enhancements

http
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Auto-balancing canvas properties like exposure, whites, and color mapping.
http
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Evaluating spatial matrices to inject digital aperture and field blur filters.

C. Inbound Job Lifecycles (Photoshop / Lightroom Engine Context)

http
GET  https://image.adobe.io/v2/status/{jobId}
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Status tracking polling route for all asynchronous actions hitting the imaging engine.

4. Vector & Workflow Scale APIs (Illustrator & Batch Pipelines)

• Base URL: https://image.adobe.io

A. Illustrator Headless Engine

http
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Running vectorization sweeps to convert raw raster inputs (JPEG/PNG) into scalable vector graphics (SVG).
http
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Injecting database variables directly into structural template layouts.

B. Creative Production Engine

http
POST https://adobe.io
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Scaling operations by executing unified workflows across thousands of media targets.

C. Inbound Job Lifecycles (Illustrator / Workflow Context)

http
GET  https://adobe.io{jobId}
GET  https://adobe.io{jobId}/image-trace
Use code with caution.
• Purpose: Tracking asynchronous vectors for structural automation workflows.
